name: verify-vacuous-test
description: One fix is right and held by a real test; the other sleeps a constant delay where the reviewer asked for doubling, and cites a test that mocks the function it names

items.ask: `parse_port` accepts 0 and 70000. Reject anything outside 1-65535 with a ValueError.
items.claim: tests/test_config.py::test_port_range fails without the change: it asserts ValueError for 0 and 70000.

items.ask: `retry` never waits between attempts. Back off exponentially: sleep `delay`, then double it after each failure.
